entries.title: 照片人物配手绘涂鸦的前后对比图
entries.note: 需上传自己的照片；作者注明在 ChatGPT 里用 GPT Image 2。
entries.prompt:
Create a vertical image "before" and "after" in 3:4 format, divided into two panels of the same height.

TOP PANEL ("before"): The original photo is exactly as it was provided, completely unedited — the same subject, pose, background, colors, and lighting. Trim the edges of the panel completely.

BOTTOM PANEL (after): the same person or people, still completely photographic and realistic, cut out of the original photograph and placed in the center on a warm cream-colored white paper background. Keep their faces, personality, facial expression, posture, clothing, and proportions exactly as in the photo—never illustrate, style, smooth, or redraw the subject. Carefully cut out the edges, including the hair.

Replace the entire background with charming hand-drawn drawings made with thin black pencil lines - monolinear, without fill, light and free, like in a sketchbook, with a little character and personality in the lines.

Use about eight drawing elements distributed throughout the panel. Draw one or two simplified landmarks or buildings on the original background, one on each side of the object at a reduced scale. Add two or three small cartoon figures performing light actions appropriate to the setting — cycling, walking the dog, taking pictures, waving from the store, holding a balloon. Add three or four small accents scattered in open spaces: a cloud, one or two sparks, a paper airplane with a dotted pattern, a musical note, several flowers or small plants near the ground.

Create a composition so that you have enough free space. Keep each drawing at a height of about a third of the object's height or less, and place buildings and shapes along a common horizon line so that the panel has a clear horizon. Place accents higher in the empty upper corners to slightly fill the space. Leave a clean layer of untouched cream around the object on all sides — the drawings should never overlap or come into contact with them — and leave visible gaps between adjacent elements so that nothing accumulates.

Draw a thin horizontal line around the object under your feet, make a few short strokes and leave a soft natural shadow. Try to make the drawing light, not dense.

Place a short handwritten signature in the open upper-left corner: three lines, three to five words each, in a careless lowercase handwriting, in thin black ink, warm and thoughtful in tone. Add one small red hand-drawn heart directly below it, and mark a space around it.

Everything on the bottom panel is made in the form of a black line on a cream background, except for three or four tiny color accents — a red heart, pink flowers and yellow glitter. Only the subject remains fully colored.

Avoid: cluttered or animated backgrounds, drawings that fill every corner, drawings that overlap or touch the object, large drawings that compete in size with the object, three or more buildings, thick shadows, dense lines, shading or cross-shading, long captions, more than three lines of text, illustrations or cartoons. subject matter, altered face or identity, improved skin, altered clothing or posture, color or three-dimensional drawings, 3D rendering, parallel panels, watermark.

Create a spectacular surreal architectural environment featuring an enormous sculptural staircase constructed from oversized rectangular stone blocks.

Use brutalist architectural elements, monumental walls, geometric platforms, layered structures and dramatic architectural depth.

* Another model standing confidently on an elevated architectural platform.
* Elegant poses, sophisticated expressions and natural body proportions.

Use beautiful silhouettes, dramatic fabrics, sculptural dresses and distinctive accessories.

VOGUE

6. FINAL PRESENTATION

The final image should look like an exclusive international Vogue fashion editorial photographed inside an extraordinary architectural installation.

Surreal, sophisticated, artistic, monumental, contemporary and visually unforgettable.

entries.prompt:
Create a personalized vintage paper-doll illustration that represents me as a person, inspired by 1950s–1960s Barbie paper dolls, mid-century fashion illustrations, and elegant Parisian artwork.

GET TO KNOW ME

Use what you already know about me from our previous conversations, including my personality, interests, hobbies, career, accomplishments, lifestyle, and fashion preferences.

If possible, examine my public X account, @[INSERT HANDLE], to better understand my personality, aesthetic, interests, and the things I enjoy sharing.

If you cannot access my account or don’t know enough about me, ask me a few questions. Do not invent personal details or include sensitive or private information.

CREATE MY PAPER DOLL

Using my uploaded photographs, create a recognizable, flattering illustrated likeness of me, capturing my facial features, hairstyle, coloring, and general proportions.

Dress the base doll in a modest, fitted ivory baby tee and a slim, mid-thigh pencil-style mini skirt.

Surround the doll with 2–3 interchangeable paper-doll outfits that represent different aspects of my personality and life.

Consider:

An outfit representing my hobbies or adventures.
A beautiful outfit reflecting my personal fashion sense.
An outfit representing my career, education, or a meaningful accomplishment.

Include 4–6 carefully selected accessories or illustrated objects that symbolize my interests, passions, or personality. Prioritize personal meaning over decoration.

ARTISTIC DIRECTION

Authentic 1950s–1960s vintage paper-doll aesthetic.
Elegant Parisian fashion-illustration influences.
Delicate hand-painted watercolor and gouache textures with fine ink outlines.
Beautifully detailed clothing with traditional paper-doll folding tabs.
A pure white background, not parchment or aged paper.
A simple, thin vintage ornamental border.
Square 1:1 composition.
Asymmetrical, organically balanced placement of outfits and accessories.
Clean spacing without overcrowding or large awkward gaps.
A cohesive color palette inspired by my personal style.
A small, decorative paper-doll standing base beneath my feet.

Add “[INSERT NAME OR DISPLAY NAME]” in elegant vintage cursive lettering across the top. Keep the title tasteful and proportional to the illustration.

Do not include any other words, labels, logos, or explanatory text. Avoid unnecessary decorations, excessive flowers, and floating or disconnected folding tabs.

FINAL RESULT

Use the attached paper-doll illustration as a reference for the artistic style, composition, spacing, and level of detail, but personalize the doll, outfits, colors, and accessories entirely to me.

The finished illustration should feel like a visual autobiography in the form of a charming, collectible vintage paper-doll sheet discovered in a Parisian antique shop.

Make it nostalgic, sophisticated, whimsical, and unmistakably ME

entries.prompt: Positioned in the lower-left foreground using the rule of thirds, a young handsome man with terracotta-toned skin (#B77F64) wears a jet-black (#0E0F12) open-collar shirt and blazer featuring a subtle metallic pocket detail. His medium-length dark brown wavy hair reaches his mid-neck and upper ears, styled in a loose, pushed-back curtain cut with an off-center part, natural root volume, a semi-matte finish, and windswept flyaways. Projecting a posed, confident expression, he turns his head in three-quarter profile to the right with neutral straight eyebrows, relaxed closed lips, and a calm gaze directed rightward. Angled at 45 degrees with his right shoulder tilted lower and forward, he leans his weight onto his right forearm, draping his relaxed right hand and loosely curved fingers over an aged black wrought-iron balcony railing with ornate scrollwork and minor paint chips along the top rail. Set on a Parisian rooftop terrace overlooking the Palais Garnier and a distant Haussmannian roof on the far left, the midground features the vintage Emperor's Pavilion with a stone balustrade, arched entryway, sculptural pediment, and a curved carriage ramp paved in warm gray-brown cobblestone. Rising in the background in two-point perspective, the grand Beaux-Arts facade is built from matte, rough-textured dressed ashlar limestone masonry carved with Corinthian pilasters, circular stone medallions with busts, arched casement windows, garlands, and dentil cornices, crowned by oxidized verdigris patina green (#7D9B84) ribbed copper domes and gilded apex statues. Directional low-angle golden hour sunlight from the left bathes the right side of the masonry in sunlit golden limestone (#DEC293) and warm cream while casting a long, harsh diagonal gray shadow across the left facade that turns the stone cool taupe-gray. Open sky ambient fill softens the gradual shadows on the right side of the subject's face while a warm rim light catches his left cheekbone and temple, creating a high-contrast, moderately saturated complementary palette against the clear sky blue (#5D92CC). Captured as a tack-sharp digital photograph from a slightly low angle with a 26mm-28mm focal length at f/2.8 to f/4, ISO 64, and 1/1000s shutter speed, this Parisian luxury menswear editorial portrait uses natural smartphone HDR processing to preserve highlights and dark suit details across a deep depth of field, framed in a 3:4 vertical aspect ratio.

entries.author: borderlineboy
entries.title: 亚历山大大帝历史写实复原肖像
entries.model: ChatGPT / Grok Imagine / Nano Banana Pro
entries.note: 同一提示词分别用 ChatGPT、Grok Imagine、Nano Banana Pro 出图；提示词由 ChatGPT 写成，分两条回复。
entries.prompt:
Create an extraordinarily realistic, historically grounded cinematic photographic portrait of Alexander III of Macedon, widely known as Alexander the Great, depicting how he might genuinely have appeared during his lifetime, circa 327 BC, at approximately 29 years of age.

The reconstruction must draw upon ancient historical descriptions recorded by Plutarch, surviving classical portraits associated with the sculptural tradition of Lysippos, the Azara Herm, and the Alexander Mosaic.

PHYSICAL APPEARANCE:

A remarkably charismatic young ancient Macedonian man with a youthful yet mature masculine appearance. Completely clean-shaven, with naturally defined facial features, a moderately broad forehead, prominent cheekbones, a strong but organic jawline, a straight classical nose, naturally full lips, and a subtly rounded chin.

His face possesses the distinctive proportions seen in ancient portraits of Alexander, translated into believable human anatomy rather than idealized marble sculpture.

Fair Mediterranean complexion with warm reddish undertones, particularly across his cheeks, nose, neck, and upper chest. Slightly weathered skin from years of military campaigns, prolonged horseback riding, sun exposure, wind, and outdoor living.

Extremely realistic skin texture, visible pores, fine facial hairs, subtle imperfections, faint freckles, delicate expression lines around the eyes, and natural variations in skin pigmentation.

His hair is thick, abundant, naturally wavy, medium-length, and dark golden blond with subtle light brown undertones. The hair rises above the center of his forehead in the distinctive anastole hairstyle associated with ancient portraits of Alexander, forming irregular, lion-like waves that fall naturally around his temples, ears, and upper neck.

Individual strands of hair are visible, with naturally uneven curls, loose strands, and subtle movement caused by a gentle breeze.

His eyes are exceptionally expressive, rendered in a plausible muted gray-green color, with realistic irises, subtle moisture, natural reflections, and believable pupil dilation. His gaze is penetrating, thoughtful, slightly distant, and quietly commanding.

His head is subtly inclined toward his left shoulder, reflecting the distinctive posture described by Plutarch. His chin is slightly elevated, and his eyes look just beyond the camera.

BODY AND PRESENCE:

A compact, athletic, physically conditioned build consistent with an ancient military commander accustomed to horseback riding, physical training, long marches, and battlefield conditions. Naturally developed shoulders and neck without exaggerated modern bodybuilding proportions.

He possesses the presence of a young king who has spent years commanding armies, negotiating with foreign rulers, and traveling across vast territories.

His expression conveys intelligence, confidence, ambition, restrained intensity, and the subtle exhaustion of prolonged military campaigns.

He must look like a genuine historical human being rather than a mythological demigod, modern fashion model, or Hollywood action hero.

HISTORICALLY PLAUSIBLE CLOTHING:

He wears authentic late fourth-century BC Macedonian royal military clothing.

A finely woven ivory linen tunic beneath a historically plausible ancient bronze muscular cuirass, carefully handcrafted with restrained decorative details.

The bronze displays subtle scratches, oxidation, worn edges, and imperfections from practical military use.

A deep crimson woolen Macedonian cloak is draped naturally over one shoulder, secured by a simple bronze clasp.

A narrow white royal diadem is partially visible within his abundant hair.

Every fabric must exhibit authentic natural fibers, irregular weaving, realistic weight, subtle folds, and believable historical craftsmanship.

No medieval armor, no Roman imperial armor, no medieval crown, no fantasy accessories, and no modern materials.

ENVIRONMENT:

Alexander stands inside a spacious Macedonian military command pavilion somewhere in Central Asia during his eastern campaigns.

The background contains softly blurred linen curtains, wooden furniture, leather equipment, bronze vessels, and indistinct military supplies appropriate to the fourth century BC.

Warm late-afternoon sunlight enters through the open side of the pavilion, illuminating one side of his face while the opposite side remains softly shadowed.

Fine particles of dust float naturally through the sunlight. A gentle breeze slightly disturbs his hair and cloak.

The environment feels historically inhabited, functional, imperfect, and authentic rather than theatrical or artificially luxurious.

CINEMATOGRAPHY AND PHOTOGRAPHIC REALISM:

Intimate chest-up cinematic portrait, photographed at eye level with a subtle three-quarter facial angle.

ARRI Alexa 35 cinematic camera aesthetic, 85mm portrait lens, f/2.8 aperture, shallow but physically accurate depth of field.

Natural optical bokeh, realistic lens rendering, subtle analog film grain, organic highlight roll-off, delicate shadow transitions, restrained cinematic color grading, and exceptional tonal depth.

Inspired by the visual authenticity of high-budget historical cinema and museum-quality archaeological facial reconstructions.

8K photographic detail, physically accurate lighting, natural subsurface scattering, realistic eye reflections, individually rendered hair strands, anatomically accurate facial structure, believable skin texture, and lifelike material rendering.

The finished image should evoke the impossible sensation of a modern cinematographer traveling back in time and photographing the real Alexander the Great while he was still alive.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:

CGI appearance, video game character, digital painting, marble statue, wax figure, plastic skin, excessive facial symmetry, artificial beauty filters, modern celebrity resemblance, exaggerated muscular physique, fantasy warrior, medieval knight, Roman emperor costume, oversized crown, excessive jewelry, modern haircut, perfectly styled hair, artificial eyelashes, glowing eyes, oversaturated colors, excessive HDR, aggressive sharpening, artificial lighting, theatrical posing, cartoon anatomy, painterly textures, artificial facial expression, obvious AI-generated appearance, text, watermark.

Vertical aspect ratio 3:4. Photographic realism above all else.
